description: Card B2's litre superbike: a 998 cc crossplane four with four valves a cylinder and individual throttle bodies, redline 14,000.

targets.name: Starts and runs
targets.source: a warm engine started on its key runs (engine.state 2)

targets.name: Within full scale
targets.source: 02-contracts.md, section 1: what process writes is within +-1

targets.name: Holds the limiter
targets.source: a fuel-cut or ignition-cut rev limiter holds the speed within a few percent of where it cuts

targets.name: Peak torque
targets.source: a litre superbike four makes 110 to 120 N m at 10,000 to 11,500 rpm (makers' claims). Reported, not failed: a miss until the engine's breathing and friction at high piston speed are right (card B2's handoff).

targets.name: Peak power
targets.source: a litre superbike four makes about 140 kW at 13,000 rpm at the crank (makers' claims for 2015-2020 models, 145 to 155 kW; Cycle World measured 159.8 hp, 119 kW, at the wheel of a 2012 GSX-R1000). Reported, not failed: as above.
